subject: general
question: If the amount obtained by A by investing Rs. 9,100 for three years at a rate of 10% p.a. on simple interest is equal to the amount obtained by B by investing a certain sum of money for five years at a rate of 8% p.a. on simple interest, then 90% of the sum invested by B (in Rs.) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Interest % for A = 10% × 3 = 30% | Total Interest % for B = 8% × 5 = 40%

Amount % for A = 130% | Amount % for B = 140%

Equating Amounts: 130% of 9,100 = 140% of Principal B

Principal B = (130 ÷ 140) × 9,100 = (13 ÷ 14) × 9,100 = 13 × 650 = ₹8,450

Required value = 90% of 8,450 = 0.9 × 8,450 = ₹7,605

**∴ The correct answer is ₹7,605.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Principal A (PA) = ₹9,100, Rate A (RA) = 10%, Time A (TA) = 3 years. Rate B (RB) = 8%, Time B (TB) = 5 years. Amount A = Amount B.

**Formula Used:** SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100 | Amount = P + SI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d18e57ca9b014efce37b27ea0dec360d604e7993447d072a58fcc2b24d1e484.png] 

⇒ Simple Interest for A = (9,100 × 10 × 3) ÷ 100

⇒ SIA = ₹2,730

⇒ Amount A = 9,100 + 2,730 = ₹11,830

⇒ Amount B = PrincipalB × (1 + (8 × 5) ÷ 100)

⇒ 11,830 = PrincipalB × (1 + 0.40)

⇒ 11,830 = 1.4 × PrincipalB

⇒ PrincipalB = 11,830 ÷ 1.4 = ₹8,450

⇒ Required Value = 90% of PrincipalB = 0.90 × 8,450

⇒ Required Value = ₹7,605

**∴ The correct answer is ₹7,605.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Amount

The total amount (A) is the sum of the principal (P) and interest (I). It is calculated as A = P(1 + RT/100).

Equal Amounts Logic

When two different investments result in equal amounts, the ratio of their principals is P₁ : P₂ = (100 + R₂T₂) : (100 + R₁T₁).

Percentage Change

To find x% of a value V, multiply the value by (x/100). For 90%, the multiplying factor is 0.9.
